verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own marketing explicitly promises workflow automation for SLAs, trial extensions, and discount offers (featurebase-docs-3), backed by webhook support that reacts to feedback/status events (featurebase-docs-1). However, there is no documentation of the actual workflow builder UI, trigger/condition/action configuration, or independent/hands-on confirmation that these automations work as advertised. Missing for 10: detailed workflow-builder documentation, example configurations, and independent or hands-on verification of SLA/trial/discount automation in practice.
